slides.texte_overlay:
bizarre habits to make you
the most magnetic person
in the room

the last to look away

in conversations this week, hold eye contact one second longer than feels natural before looking away. it reads as calm, confident and genuinely interested.

asking a second question

when someone answers your question, ask one more about what they just said. most people stop at one, so the second question makes people feel truly heard.

a slower voice

speak a little slower and a little lower for one week. a relaxed voice makes people lean in, and it tells everyone you're comfortable and in no hurry.

one fascinating thing

learn one fascinating thing every day in 5 minutes, like a strange animal or a lost city. people always drift towards whoever has the best story to tell.

leaving first

leave parties and conversations while they're still good, not when they fade. people remember the ones who left on a high note and want to see them again.
